{{TOCright}}
Escort reinforcements to the entrance of [[Sunjiang District (outpost)|Sunjiang District]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Meet the [[Royal Guard (Factions)|Royal Guard]] in the [[Shenzun Tunnels]].
* Escort the Royal Guard to [[Commander Jafai]].
* See [[Royal Guard Kazuya]] for your reward.

===Reward===
*3,000 [[Experience]]
*150 [[Gold]]
*1 [[Skill Point]]

==Walkthrough==
After you've been given the quest, map travel to [[Tahnnakai Temple (outpost)|Tahnnakai Temple]] or [[Maatu Keep]]. You will find a group of 10 Royal Guards outside. Follow the directions and clear the [[mob]]s in your way. Make sure you keep at least one Guard alive while traveling to Commander Jafai. If you have succeeded, Commander Jafai will let you into the [[Sunjiang District (outpost)|Sunjiang District outpost]]. Do not linger around since there will be more groups of [[Afflicted]] approaching once you get near the commander.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Emperor's Hand
''The emperor tells me that you are heading to the Sunjiang District to fight Shiro. You are either very brave or very foolhardy. Commander Jafai is holding down the front lines there, but I do not think things are going in our favor. Escort these members of the emperor's '''Royal Guard''' to '''Commander Jafai''' to help reinforce his position.''
{{Offer dialog
| accept =  Just doing my duty to the emperor.
| decline =  On second thought, it does sound foolhardy.
| ask = I have sent word to Commander Jafai in the Sunjiang District to expect you and the Royal Guard. You should make haste, they really need the reinforcements.}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Commander Jafai
''You have no idea how relieved I am to see you. These reinforcements will help save many lives. Let me know when you are ready, and we will secure an area for you within.''
:{{yes|ingame}} '''Let's go.'''
:''It is good you have come; we need all the help we can get! If you are ready we can push forward into the Sunjiang District.''
::{{yes|ingame}} '''I am ready.'''
::''Your entire party is about to be moved to the next area. Make sure all party members are ready first. Do you wish to continue?''
:::{{yes|ingame}} '''Yes.''' (sent to [[Battle in the Sewers (cinematic)]])
:::{{no|ingame}} '''No.'''
::{{no|ingame}}  '''Not right now.'''

===Reward dialogue===
;Royal Guard Kazuya
''We have reinforced this area, but I do not know how long we can hold out against this onslaught. With each body we can buy you a chance to stop Shiro. I'm starting to think the stench down here is never going to leave my nostrils....''

==Notes==
{{bug|Two groups of [[Afflicted Warrior]]s and [[Afflicted Assassin|Assassins]] (that [[spawn]] due to this quest) on the way to Commander Jafai won't move or [[attack]], and use no [[skill]]s except [[Endure Pain]] (used by the Afflicted Warriors).}}
{{bug|Sometimes the allied [[Royal Guard]]s won't spawn when you enter [[Shenzun Tunnels]]. Rezoning seems to fix this.}}
